evidence: A screen on products: stated rules applied to the design surface's land at 16 px/deg, with the moisture map's classes and night regimes at the climate model's cells of about 170 km, the satoyama map's candidate valleys, the redrawn regions and districts and the design routing. The shares of wild and hybrid land are the register's; where each kind lies follows rules of which several are proposals (rules, parameters). The people's needs are the distributions and food studies' figures for C' at 8 billion with the blend, worked on the land of October and carried in km2. The climate is an estimate and nothing here is validated against a design of any place.
reading_rule: Shares are of land area. wild, hybrid and open add to 1 in every group; filled is the part of the open land that C' at 8 billion takes at its high end and is counted inside open. Regions and districts carry the redrawn atlas's codes. room.by_band gives, for each of C's bands, the open land in it, the need, the land placed and the shortfall, at the low and the high end. A variant's fails lists what it does not meet of the register's shares and of the room for the people. districts gives [wild, hybrid, open, filled] by district code. by_whole_districts gives what the same sorting comes to when each district takes the one kind that holds most of its land: the shares of the land, the districts by kind, those where no kind holds more than half, and the share of the land that lies in its district's kind.

proposal.gardens_order: nearest a sea or great lake first
proposal.wild_order: the land ranked last for habitation first, in each moisture class and night regime

rules.rule: The land within 32 km of the summit port (5.4 N, 158.6 W) is the metropolis: habitation.
rules.source: decisions.md, The summit port and metropolis, 27 September 2026

rules.rule: Jura Island: the high arc, the outer coasts and the islets are wild and the rest is hybrid, with one harbour town on the inner bay, which is smaller than a cell and is not drawn.
rules.source: decisions.md, Jura Island, 15 October 2026; the high arc as land more than 1 km above the sea and the outer coasts as land within 5 km of the sea outside the bay are proposals

rules.rule: The satoyama-like candidate valleys are hybrid land.
rules.source: decisions.md, 16 November 2026: much of the satoyama-like activity lies in the hybrid land

rules.rule: Gardens fill the hybrid share from the drylands, the land nearest a sea or a great lake first.
rules.state: register for the dry land, proposal for the order
rules.source: decisions.md, 11 and 12 October 2026: megaparks and great gardens built round the lower water; the order by nearness to water follows Jura's garden shores and the resort study's cost of lifting water

rules.rule: In every moisture class, and within it in every night regime, the wild keeps its share, taken from the land ranked last for dense living.
rules.state: register for the share of the land and of the dark sky, study for holding it zone by zone, proposal for the night regimes and the order
rules.source: decisions.md, 11 October 2026; the food and distributions studies hold the share in every zone; the night regimes are the moisture map's, so that the land with the darkest nights keeps its wild share too

rules.rule: The land left is open to habitation and its farms, ranked: dry highlands poleward of 30 deg, the high-latitude lowland, the homestead belt, the rain belt, dry highlands within 30 deg, other land.
rules.state: register for the direction, study for the bands
rules.source: decisions.md, 11 October 2026 (the drier highlands; homesteads in the middle latitudes; the rest where it is better sustained); distributions (C') and land cities for the bands and their limits

limits: The moisture classes, night regimes, rain and warmth are the climate model's cells, about 170 km across; a cell the model holds as water takes its nearest land cell's values, which errs dry in the lake districts.
Distances to water are measured in bands of 5 degrees at each band's mean cell width and capped at 300 km; a great lake is one of 1,000 km2 or more at 1.9 km cells.
The needs by band are bounds built from the studies' printed ranges; the studies' own corners pair the ranges differently, and their totals are in carried.
A town, a crater garden town or a harbour is smaller than a cell: the open land is where such places may stand, and no site is chosen.
